=== task: add ===

--- exit: exit status 206
task: Task "exec" cancelled because it is missing required variables: BINARY

=== task: install ===

  bash "$tmpfile"
  bash "$tmpfile" "bun-vBASE-VERSION"
  echo 'Installing Bun (latest)...'
  echo 'Installing Bun vBASE-VERSION...'
curl -fsSL "BASE-BUN_INSTALL_URL" -o "$tmpfile"
else
else
fi
fi
if [ -n "BASE-VERSION" ]; then
task: "_install:unix" finished
task: "_install:unix" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: [_install:unix] echo 'Bun installed. Restart your shell or add ~/.bun/bin to PATH to use bun.'
task: [_install:unix] if [ -n "BASE-VERSION" ]; then
task: status command bun_bin="$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"; if [ ! -x "$bun_bin" ]; then bun_bin="$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null)"; fi; [ -n "$bun_bin" ] && [ -x "$bun_bin" ] && { [ -z "BASE-VERSION" ] || [ "$("$bun_bin" --version)" = "BASE-VERSION" ]; } exited non-zero: exit status 1
tmpfile=$(mktemp /tmp/bun-install.XXXXXX.sh)
trap 'rm -f "$tmpfile"' EXIT

=== task: install:undo ===
task: "_install:undo:unix" finished
task: "_install:undo:unix" started
task: "_install:undo:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "install:undo" finished
task: "install:undo" started
task: [_install:undo:unix] bash -c 'found=$(grep -rl "BUN_INSTALL\|\.bun/bin" "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.bash_profile" "$HOME/.profile" "$HOME/.zshrc" 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$found" ] && echo "Manually remove Bun lines from:" && echo "$found" | sed "s/^/  /" || echo "No Bun references found in shell profile files."'
task: [_install:undo:unix] echo 'Bun removed.'
task: [_install:undo:unix] echo 'Removing Bun from "$HOME/.bun"...'

=== task: upgrade ===

  bash "$tmpfile"
  bash "$tmpfile" "bun-vBASE-VERSION"
  echo 'Installing Bun (latest)...'
  echo 'Installing Bun vBASE-VERSION...'
curl -fsSL "BASE-BUN_INSTALL_URL" -o "$tmpfile"
else
else
fi
fi

task: "_install:unix" finished
task: "_install:unix" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_upgrade:unix" finished
task: "_upgrade:unix" started
task: "_upgrade:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: "upgrade" finished
task: "upgrade" started
task: [_install:unix] echo 'Bun installed. Restart your shell or add ~/.bun/bin to PATH to use bun.'
task: [_install:unix] if [ -n "BASE-VERSION" ]; then
task: [_upgrade:unix] bash -lc 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; bun upgrade'
task: [_upgrade:unix] echo Upgrading Bun to the latest stable release...
task: status command bun_bin="$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"; if [ ! -x "$bun_bin" ]; then bun_bin="$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null)"; fi; [ -n "$bun_bin" ] && [ -x "$bun_bin" ] && { [ -z "BASE-VERSION" ] || [ "$("$bun_bin" --version)" = "BASE-VERSION" ]; } exited non-zero: exit status 1
